next.reason: 1985: alphanumeric edited uses only 'A', 'X', '9', 'B', '0', '/' and 'must contain at least one A or X and must contain at least one B or 0 (zero) or / (slant)'. §2023:13.18.40.4 GR7: 'at least one symbol A or one symbol X, and at least one instance of character-1 or one of the symbols from the set B, 0, /': character-1 of the new EDITING phrase is an added way to make an item alphanumeric-edited. Allowed combinations are those of §2023:13.18.40.3 SR2 (precedence table); content per symbol in §2023:13.18.40.4 GR14. Looser through the added symbol.
